Interactive maps with leaflet

Source: R/leaflet.R
phw_leaflet.Rd

phw_leaflet() starts a leaflet::leaflet() map with a light, quiet base map and the PHW font, centred on Wales. phw_leaflet_polygons() adds filled areas (e.g. from phw_boundaries()) with PHW colours, hover labels and a legend in one call. phw_leaflet_palette() gives a leaflet colour function from any PHW palette, for your own layers.

Usage

phw_leaflet(data = NULL, tiles = "Esri.WorldGrayCanvas", view = "wales", ...)

phw_leaflet_polygons(
  map,
  data,
  fill = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  bins = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  popup = NULL,
  legend_title = fill,
  opacity = 0.8,
  weight = 1,
  colour = "#FFFFFF",
  key = NULL,
  polygon_args = list()
)

phw_leaflet_palette(
  palette = "blues",
  domain,
  type = c("numeric", "bin", "quantile", "factor"),
  bins = 5,
  reverse = FALSE,
  na.color = phw_colours[["grey_light"]]
)

Arguments

data

Optional data for the map, as in leaflet::leaflet().

tiles

Base map from leaflet::providers, or NULL for none. The default is a light grey map (Esri World Gray Canvas, which needs no API key) that keeps your colours readable.

view

"wales" to start on Wales, or NULL to fit the data.

...

Passed to leaflet::leaflet().

map

A leaflet map.

fill

Column of data to colour by, unquoted as in dplyr (a string works too). Numbers get a continuous or binned scale; text and factors get distinct colours.

palette

Palette name or colours, as in phw_pal(). Defaults to "blues" for numbers and the default palette for groups.

bins

Number of bins, or a vector of breaks, for numeric fill. NULL gives a continuous scale.

label, popup

What to show on hover and on click: a column of data, unquoted, or an expression built from its columns such as paste(name, rate). A string naming a column, or a vector with one value per row, works too.

legend_title

Legend title, or NULL for no legend. Defaults to the name of the fill column.

opacity

Fill opacity.

weight, colour

Outline width and colour.

key

Name of a colour key, so groups keep their colours (see phw_colour_key()).

polygon_args

List of other leaflet::addPolygons() arguments.

domain

Values the palette should cover.

type

"numeric" (continuous), "bin", "quantile" or "factor".

reverse

Reverse the palette?

na.color

Colour for missing values.

Value

A leaflet map.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  phw_leaflet()
}


# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) &&
    interactive()) {
  hb <- phw_boundaries("health_board", crs = 4326)
  hb$rate <- runif(nrow(hb), 10, 50)
  phw_leaflet() |>
    phw_leaflet_polygons(hb, fill = rate, label = name, legend_title = "Rate")
}
# }
